ctx.x: How about some of the other people, like Hoagy Carmichael?

Yes, I met Hoagy Carmichael. And, of course, I think this was in California. I was with Lena Horne at the time that I first met him in person, and he was such a nice guy. Had a heavy voice for such a little guy too, you know. But, oh, boy, that immortal Stardust. I guess that will live forever, you know.
